snippet.title: Dragon Shelter - Cooking & Crafting Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3726280/Dragon_Shelter_Demo/
Wishlist the game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2712590/Dragon_Shelter/
 
Dragon Shelter is a farming sim set in a fantasy world. Become a hero who'll reignite the long-lost friendship between humans and dragons. Care for wondrous creatures, explore the magical world, and cook enchanted dishes together!
 
Join the Dragon Shelter community on:

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/JcRZUZHC9e
X: https://x.com/DragonShelterWF
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/dragonsheltergame.bsky.social
